title: [133] First recording after app launch loses first ~30 s of system audio ([Them] track)
why_we_need_this: On the first recording after the app starts, the system audio track is shorter than the mic track and [Them] lines are missing for the first ~30 s (example 14.10.2026 15:46:53: system 00:00:56 vs mic 00:01:25, banner "System audio track is shorter than mic"). Second and later recordings are fine. Users lose the other party's speech at the start of every session after launch.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Root cause identified from code/logs (server system capture start path on Windows and macOS, cold-start behaviour such as loopback/audiotee warm-up, self-test, lazy init, late first data) and documented in the task.
2. After a fresh app launch, the first recording has a system audio track whose duration matches the mic track (within ~1 s) and [Them] lines appear from the start.
3. Second and later recordings behave as before (no regression).
4. Fix works on both Windows and macOS (or macOS impact explicitly assessed).
5. project-context updated with the cause and the fix.
important_constraints: Two platforms: macOS and Windows. Do not show diagnostics (offsets, dB, method names) in user UI; keep in logs. Other agents may be editing files in the working tree; do not revert their changes.
